notes: OGClubCreatorPool pays $OG each month to the payout wallets of games listed in OG Club World. constructor(IERC20 token, address owner). token is the live Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1) $OG ERC-20 at 0xCe7EB1Ad9e2E1c784ea05F7eA4A0Fe625923D10A. This is the requester's own deployed token, not a placeholder or guess: on 2026-10-25 a mainnet read through a public RPC returned name OG, symbol OG, 18 decimals, totalSupply 1e27 (1,000,000,000 OG) for that address, and the live OG Club farm vault at 0x60401e748d6c3a1f2775bE9e6a41bda20eDa0B80 returned token() = 0xCe7EB1Ad9e2E1c784ea05F7eA4A0Fe625923D10A and owner() = 0x5b95a971b4583a5f011e9da082acdd679b870d06, which is this launch's $owner. The brief's mainnet deploy script reads the same value from env OG_TOKEN; the manifest fixes it statically because a manifest cannot read the environment. The token is immutable and the constructor only checks it is nonzero and stores it, so deployment on the empty rehearsal chain succeeds. owner is $owner (Ownable2Step two-step handover; renounceOwnership is disabled so months can always be proposed). The owner can list, delist and relist games, propose a month (Merkle root plus total <= free(), opens after a 3-day delay, claimable for 90 days) and cancel a month only before it opens. The owner cannot withdraw, sweep to itself, change a game's payout wallet (only the current payout wallet can), change the token, or touch a month's money once its 3-day delay has passed. $OG only leaves as claims paid to games' payout wallets; sweep returns unclaimed amounts to free() inside the pool. Money arrives by plain ERC-20 transfer (farm vault season claims naming the pool as an account) or fund(amount). No ETH, no receive, no proxy, no delegatecall, no selfdestruct. This launch deploys nothing else: no token, pool or initialization call. After launch the owner lists games with listGame(gameId(kitId), payoutWallet) and adds the pool's address to vault seasons (out of scope).
